```swift title="Swift"

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"List items until you see STOP\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stop\":[\"STOP\",\"END\"]}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
```
